title: The More You Stack, The More You Save
copy: Fuel up for less when you pay with the Fuel Forward™ App. Stack a First Time Discount with the Every Day Savings. Maybe pay with Direct Pay or a Phillips 66®, Conoco® or 76® credit card to stack even more and make your fuel price go low. Promos vary from day to day, so stay tuned for what you can stack and when. Download the app, set up your payment method and start stacking discounts today! Terms and conditions apply.
